a: CI automatically builds and tests on every push.
CD automatically deploys verified builds to environments.
Blue-green keeps two environments and switches traffic for safe releases.
Canary releases send a small percent of traffic to the new version first.
A rollback restores the previous known-good version quickly.
Logs, metrics, and traces help you understand production behavior.
SLA is a promised service level, often uptime percentage.
Incidents are unplanned disruptions; document timeline and fixes.
IaC defines infrastructure in versioned config files.
Rotate secrets regularly and after any leak.
